launcher-capability.description: Capability for the IRIS Launcher window. In dev this window loads the launcher's own Vite server on :8080, which Tauri treats as a REMOTE origin — without the `remote` block below it can render but cannot use the IPC at all, so launch_widget would never reach Rust. In a packaged build the same window loads launcher/index.html from the app bundle and the remote entry is unused.

wings-capability.description: Capability for wings detached into their own windows. A detached wing runs the same frontend as the widget and drives the same shared WS client, so it needs the widget's permissions. In DEV it is built with WebviewUrl::External pointing at the Next dev server, which Tauri classifies as a remote origin even though the widget reaches that same server through devUrl — a remote window gets no IPC at all without the `remote` block below, so reattach_wing would never reach Rust. A packaged build loads index.html from the bundle and the remote entry is unused.
